description: Verify that the applied diff contains exactly one hunk header (e.g., @@ ... @@).
Ensure the diff does not contain any lines starting with '+++' or '---' other than the file header lines, indicating no unintended context or deletion/addition markers from the unselected hunk.
Confirm that the diff starts with a valid file header line (e.g., '--- a/file' or '+++ b/file').
Validate that the diff ends with a newline character to ensure proper formatting.
